freeze_scope: candidate-pool size-matched random-removal masks, from-scratch retraining, and BCA/ASR endpoints; source victims, detector scores, and detector-guided post-filter outcomes already exist

fixed_detector_postfilter_comparator.chronology: known before this addendum was frozen

candidate_random_removal.population: the frozen detector-eligible target-class candidate positions, including every poison record
candidate_random_removal.size: exactly the number removed by the corresponding detector

retraining.architecture_optimizer_epochs_batch_size: identical to the source victim protocol
retraining.initialization_seed: same victim seed as the detector-guided post-filter condition

analysis.primary_contrast: paired detector-guided minus candidate-pool size-matched-random attack success rate
analysis.utility_contrast: paired detector-guided minus candidate-pool size-matched-random balanced clean accuracy
analysis.support_rule_per_detector: the 95% bootstrap upper bound for paired ASR difference is below zero and mean paired BCA difference is at least -0.05

interpretation.role: stronger fairness control for the detector-eligible candidate universe
interpretation.not_fully_prospective: detector-guided outcomes were known before this addendum freeze
